data.subject: Local Ledger weekly issue and pilot
data.body:
Hi,

Your most recent 13F, for June 30, 2026, shows positions in AXR, OPBK, and MGYR.

A recent AXR filing reports Q2 2026 revenue of $6.1M versus $17.9M a year earlier (-66.1% y/y) (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/6207/000110465926107084/0001104659-26-107084-index.htm).

Local Ledger is independent research on under-covered US microcaps, built from local and state public records (permits, agendas, call reports, filings), with every claim cited.

I can send the free weekly issue and outline a four-week fund pilot. Reply 'no' and I won't follow up.
